english.title: Intentionally fail to comply with an inspection / sampling / seizure requirement by an inspector
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) intentionally failed to comply with an inspection, sampling or seizure requirement, namely **(..SPECIFY NATURE OF REQUIREMENT..), properly made by an Inspector under regulation 327 of the Human Medicines Regulations 2012
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 334(3)(b) and (4) of the Human Medicines Regulations 2012.

english.notes: Regulations 339(1) of the Human Medicines Regulations 2012 provides that a magistrates' court in England or Wales may try an information for an offence under these Regulations that is triable only summarily if the information was laid at any time within the period of twelve months beginning with the commission of the offence.
